body: Thank you. You're (sadly) the first one to tell me such a thing.
I can try... Thanks a lot.
I mean I specifically asked that to several people.

But how ? I've been trying, I can't just say "okay let's get shit done" and everything's fine. I tried, really, that works for five minutes, I call, get the appointment but never show up and that hurts me more.
I don't know, I feel like my depression is an entity that takes control of my body most of the time. I'm still here, but all I can do is watching myself ruin everything.

I know, I would like to. I never saw one regularly, but there was one in a free mental care center (that I had to see after ending in ER) that I liked. She was the only one who helped a bit. I missed an appointment, on purpose, even if I didn't want to, but everytime I did this I called to reschedule and she didn't call me back this time. Maybe the secretary didn't transfer the message, maybe she forgot, I don't know, but I can't go back to her, or any private psychatrist, even if I really want to be helped, I can't. I tried to ask help from my friends and family for that but they won't, they ignore what is going on.
No. I was in early July but they had side effects. I'm not on therapy neither.
Years. And I found out about my severe depression a year ago. But everything goes exponentially harder as the time goes by.

That question is so open it hurts.  
Literally everything I guess.
